title: Korea's constitution states the territory as the Korean peninsula and its adjacent islands
summary: Korea's constitution states the territory as the Korean peninsula and its adjacent islands.
body: Article 3 says the territory of the Republic of Korea shall consist of the Korean peninsula and its adjacent islands. The source says: "Article 3 The territory of the Republic of Korea shall consist of the Korean peninsula and its adjacent islands." This is the constitution's territorial sentence. It is not a finding about which authority administers which part of the peninsula.
